title: Abstract Security, which offers an in-stream threat detection platform, raised a $25M extension to its $15M Series A, bringing its total funding to $48.5M (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Duncan Riley / SiliconANGLE: Abstract Security, which offers an in-stream threat detection platform, raised a $25M extension to its $15M Series A, bringing its total funding to $48.5M — Composable security operations startup Abstract Security Inc. today said it has raised a $25 million Series A extension …
